scope: All public external links in the four design inspiration catalog documents, including secondary posts, quoted originals, further reading, other sampled Art directions, site destinations and supporting attribution/verification links.
keyPolicy: primaryCatalogId preserves existing stable catalog IDs. A suffix distinguishes multiple source URLs under one stable ID. WEB-SECONDARY, GRA-READ, ART-OTHER and SITE-VERIFY keys are inventory-only, not new stable catalog references.
rightsAndAttribution: These are externally authored inspiration references, distinct from Monarchic original compositions. Posting account is not assumed to establish original artwork authorship or a reuse license. This inventory supplies no downloaded media and no invented previews.
